sources.entry: Pretix - Ticket sales platform for events. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Python/Docker

summary.one_liner: pretix is an open-source ticket sales and presale platform for events, conferences, and similar gatherings, written in Python and distributed under AGPL-3.0 with a Docker option.
summary.what_it_does: The README is short and mostly describes project status, support, and contribution policy rather than detailed features. It states that pretix has been used for thousands of events and conferences that sold millions of tickets combined, and that the project considers it stable. Releases are published on PyPI and in release/X.Y branches, while master holds a development version whose APIs may change without notice. The README points to an installation guide and developer documentation hosted externally. Commercial support, hosting, and enterprise offerings are provided by the maintainers at pretix.eu, while the software itself is free and open source. Detailed feature lists are not included in the README text provided.
how_to_run: Read the installation guide in the pretix documentation to set up a self-hosted server
Install the latest stable release from PyPI
Use the release/X.Y branch of the repository for stable source
Use the master branch only for development, as its APIs may change
notable: Claims use at thousands of events and millions of tickets sold combined
Stable release branches plus a development master branch
Commercial hosting and enterprise tiers offered by the maintainers alongside free software
caveats: The master branch is a development version whose APIs may change without prior notice
Private email or phone support is only offered to pretix Hosted or Enterprise customers
Most code is AGPL-3.0 with additional terms; the README says some parts are covered by different licenses
